flows:
Navigate to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/signin?demo=1 then Click the "Sign in" button
Go to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/app/shield
Type "0x7a3f9cE5b801Dd3fA7426C9e0B1f8a5d3e27c4b9" into the "Paste a Solana, Ethereum or Base address" field
Click "Check address"
Assert the result says "Blocked"
Assert the result says it looks like Ada (Base)’s saved address but isn’t
Assert the result is labelled as an Ethereum and Base address

remark: click: Clicking the Sign in button
type: Typing the address into the Paste a Solana, Ethereum or Base address field
analyze: The result is labelled as a Base address.
assert: the result says it looks like Ada (Base)’s saved address but isn’t

summary:
The address checker is using the wrong network rules for the entered address, so it does not recognize the Ethereum/Base address or match it to Ada (Base)'s saved address.
Update Shield’s address detection so 0x-prefixed Ethereum/Base addresses are evaluated as EVM addresses and can trigger the saved-contact look-alike warning.
evidence: error_ui_text: Blocked. This isn’t a valid Solana address.
one_liner: Shield blocked the supplied valid EVM address as an invalid Solana address instead of showing the expected Ada (Base) look-alike warning.
reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the result says it looks like Ada (Base)’s saved address but isn’t"
